create_quantized_linear: create a quantized linear module with specified input and output features for inference
pack_quantized_weight_bias: pack quantized weight and bias tensors into optimized format for FBGEMM inference
convert_float_to_quantized: convert a float torch.nn.Linear module to a quantized Linear module using from_float
create_linear_from_reference: create a quantized Linear module from a reference quantized module with custom scale and zero point
set_quantized_weight_bias: set quantized weight and bias tensors on an existing LinearPackedParams module
